claim_text: Within the reviewed 480-specification NeuroMark schizophrenia multiverse artifact set, H1 is fragile, H2 is estimator-split, and H3 has limited direction-aware support; these are internally supported exploratory findings, not pre-registered biomarker claims.

public_export_notes: This public export omits private filesystem paths and restricted data.
No commitment_card.json is included because no pre-run commitment card was found on the searched surfaces.
This record should be cited as a reviewed-evidence claim card, not as a sealed pre-run commitment record.

scope_boundary.dataset: FBIRN NeuroMark 2.2 FNC case-control sample as described in the reviewed report
scope_boundary.population: 181 healthy controls and 182 schizophrenia participants, per the reviewed report
scope_boundary.artifact_scope: Reviewed report summary and BR external-review logs; restricted source data and private workspace paths are not included in this public export.

survived_checks: Latest reviewed report and rereview agree on a 480-row multiverse result table with 480 unique branch combinations and zero recorded spec errors.
H1 summary is internally consistent in the latest reviewed report and rereview: 72/384 latent-evaluable specifications favour latent representations, median delta_auc -0.0319.
H2 summary is internally consistent in the latest reviewed report and rereview: 12/24 unique H2 contrasts are favourable after deduplicating classifier/reduction duplicates.
H3 summary is internally consistent in the latest reviewed report and rereview: 100/384 latent specifications are favourable under the corrected direction-aware rule.
failed_checks: No pre-run commitment card, sealed commitment hash, claim_report.json, society/claim_card.json, or original evidence_verdicts.json was found for the original NeuroMark analysis on the searched surfaces.
The reviewed results/multiverse_full directory was reported by rereview as lacking run_manifest.json.
Raw restricted source data and private result directories are not included in this public export for direct checksum or rerun validation.
Joint specification-count p-values remain dependence-naive and should be treated as descriptive.
ComBat-adjusted H2/H3 branches still need site-by-diagnosis and residual site-predictability diagnostics before stronger group-effect interpretation.
next_required_evidence: Export a public-safe manifest for the reviewed results/multiverse_full directory, including file hashes and software versions.
If the external runner finds true original BR run-store audit files, publish those separately and identify them as original run-store artifacts.
Add dependence-aware specification-curve inference or label the binomial count tests as descriptive.
Add site-by-diagnosis and residual site-predictability diagnostics for ComBat branches.

calibration.binding_rationale: The latest reviewed report and external rereview agree on H1/H2/H3 summary values after the H3 direction fix. The binding is limited because no pre-run commitment card or original manifest-backed run bundle is available in the public export.
calibration.calibrated_claim_text: The NeuroMark case supports an exploratory, internally reviewed 480-specification multiverse summary: H1 fragile, H2 estimator-split, H3 limited under the corrected direction-aware rule. It does not support a claim that a pre-run BR commitment card existed for this analysis.
